```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- 'CX1'
cell_ID_2 <- 'CX2'

treated_2 <- FALSE

n_after_2 <- 7543

```
```{r}
x <- c(cell_ID_1, treated_1, n_before_1, n_after_1)

```

```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID = c(cell_ID_1, cell_ID_2),
  treated = c(treated_1, treated_2),
  num_cells_before = c(n_before_1, n_before_2),
  num_cells_after = c(n_after_1, n_after_2)
)
print(my_data_frame)
gt(my_data_frame)
```
